limits: 200 records per band are diagnostic samples, not exhaustive finite catalogs. Each band includes zero and both signs in its bank by code inspection; no per-batch coverage quota is imposed.
risk_cases_purpose: Preserve repeated values, all-zero matrices and every requested position in every band, without adding operations. Explicit parameter tests are not evidence about sampler frequencies.
